Everybody Hates Chris is a comedy series inspired by the teenage life of Chris Rock. Set in the 1980s, it follows a young Chris growing up in Brooklyn, dealing with school, family, and everyday struggles. The show is narrated by adult Chris Rock, adding humor and commentary to his younger self’s experiences.

The series stands out for its relatable storytelling and sharp humor, showing topics like bullying, strict parenting, and trying to fit in. Chris’s family—especially his tough father Julius and no-nonsense mother Rochelle—bring a lot of the comedy. Everybody Hates Chris is loved for being funny while still showing real-life challenges in a grounded way.
